Brief Description:
This is the risk associated with:
• Lack of a well-defined and documented
project scope that can lead to scope creep.
• Project delays leading to cost escalation.
• Inadequate human resource staffing for the
project
• Lack of a project monitoring mechanism
such as a project plan to track progress of
the project’s activities.
Further Information:
Financial risk disclosures.
CEO’s statement.
Corporate governance
statement.

governing Project imitation, planning, execution,
closure and review are adhered to for all projects:

exploit vulnerabilities of a systems and assets
